management.loopback: Management API may bind loopback; local CLI/desktop SSH forwarding requires Bearer service key and TLS server verification.
management.webConstructor: A trusted web Constructor backend connects only over private HTTPS with mTLS and a separate Bearer platform-admin token per Gateway binding.
management.desktopConstructor: Desktop uses an external OpenSSH/bastion short-lived user certificate restricted to port-forwarding into loopback Management API; the tunnel still uses TLS server verification and Bearer authorization.
management.userAuthorization: Constructor owns human users, roles, environment-scoped permissions and per-user audit; Gateway authenticates only the Controller binding principal.
management.rawKey: Service key plaintext is returned once during create/rotate; only a verifier/hash is persisted.
management.trustRoots: Management client trust roots and plugin workload trust roots MUST be distinct.
management.health: Unauthenticated health endpoint exposes process health only and no configuration or runtime inventory.

caddyAdmin.externalProcess: Gateway launches and supervises the configured compatible Caddy binary; Caddy Admin API/IPC is authenticated and private to Gateway.
caddyAdmin.dispatchSync: External Caddy receives immutable dispatch generations before activation; sync failure leaves active Caddy and dispatch generations unchanged.
caddyAdmin.gatewayPassThrough: Authenticated Management API pass-through preserves native Caddy payloads.
caddyAdmin.mutation: Every mutation creates a durable checkpoint before forwarding and writes metadata-only audit.
caddyAdmin.drift: Unrepresentable runtime changes block group publish/rollback until explicit checkpoint restore or full-composition reconcile.
caddyAdmin.reverseConversion: Arbitrary Caddy JSON is never converted back to Caddyfile automatically.

plugins.local: Gateway supervises a plugin process on an assigned loopback endpoint.
plugins.remote: A stable Service endpoint uses TLS/mTLS; each externally issued workload-replica identity maps to one logical plugin instance.
plugins.clientIdentities: Remote Gateway control RPCs and Caddy data-plane Call/Stream use distinct workload client identities and scopes; the plugin rejects RPCs outside the identity scope.
plugins.replicas: Ready replicas share protocol, release, Manifest and settings digests; every new gRPC connection repeats TLS validation and handshake.
plugins.recovery: Gateway reconnects without replaying a unary Call with unknown outcome; an interrupted Stream closes and is not migrated to another replica.
plugins.degradedMode: An unavailable plugin degrades only its bound routes; unrelated routes remain available.
plugins.dataPath: Caddy Liapoldus handler calls the plugin directly; Gateway Management API never proxies user request bodies.
plugins.grantBroker: Only a narrow plugin-to-Gateway scoped-secret redemption callback is permitted; it does not proxy client traffic.
plugins.rotation: External CA rotation uses credential replacement and rolling restart; rejected/revoked certificates fail closed.

secrets.adminAudit: Never stores native request/response bodies or sensitive headers.

storage.database: SQLite on local filesystem; network filesystem database mounts are unsupported.
storage.artifactStore: Immutable Caddyfile/plugin-settings revisions, frontend roots and checkpoints are stored separately as files.
storage.runtime: Active configuration is hydrated into an immutable in-memory snapshot; user request paths do not read SQLite or config files.
